title: Historical type master
slide_intent: Retain an original specimen because historical details are easier to compare when the evidence is concrete.
strategic_value: The old character sheet can help Lufthansa preserve characteristic proportions while updating the system.

practical_value: Compare a new alphabet with the actual historical repertoire rather than memory.
